The protein-level reports are globally imputed (every group valued in every run, no-biotin control included), so observation is taken from per-run precursor q-values: a group is observed in a run when >= 1 precursor has EG.Qvalue <= 0.01 and PG.Qvalue <= 0.01. Membership = observed in >= 2 of 3 MCF_WT_biot runs. No-biotin control (2,493 groups observed), YIPF5 KO, KO + YIPF5-WT and KO + YIPF5-I98S kept as measurements only. HeLa arms in the 120413 report are not described by the paper and not used; the paper's 2,902 surface proteins follow a nucleus/mitochondrion/ribosome annotation filter and are not used.

sucam-jhh4-carboxyl-2026.method: Surfaceome Capture by Multiplex (SUCAM) biotinylation on intact cells (1.2 million cells per reaction): amine labeling with 2 mM EZ-Link Sulfo-NHS-SS-biotin (Pierce 21331) + 2 mM EZ-Link NHS-PEG4-biotin (Pierce 21330), 30 min 4 C, then carboxyl activation (2 mM EDC + 5 mM sulfo-NHS, pH 5.7) and labeling with 2 mM EZ-Link Amine-PEG2-biotin (Thermo 21346), 40 min 4 C, glycine quench. Vehicle (PBS) mock-labeled cells processed in parallel as the bead-background control. Lysis in modified RIPA, nuclear pellet discarded, capture on Streptavidin Magnetic Beads (Pierce 88817) 3 h to overnight, RIPA/8 M urea/2 M NaCl/AMBIC washes, on-bead Trypsin/Lys-C digestion; LFQ with biotin-vs-vehicle comparison. A separate aminooxy-biotin (periodate/aniline, alkoxyamine-PEG4-biotin, streptavidin agarose) arm was used only for method comparison.

Only available biological replicates retained, no mock rows recovered. No annotation whitelist; diagnostic presence, not enrichment or replicate-reproducibility evidence.

laccid-2025.method: Genetically encoded cell-surface proximity labeling: primary human CD8+ T cells lentivirally expressing surface-displayed LaccID (an O2-dependent laccase evolved from an ancestral fungal laccase; active selectively at the plasma membrane) were labeled live with 250 uM biotin-methoxyphenol (BMP) for 2 h at 37 C, quenched with 10 mM sodium ascorbate / 5 mM Trolox; 40 million cells per sample (LaccID-only T cells for the monoculture arm used here; TCR- or CAR-expressing T cells cocultured 24 h with A375 tumor cells at 3:1 for the other arms). RIPA lysis with quenchers, azide and benzonase; capture on streptavidin magnetic beads 1 h RT; washes with RIPA, 1 M KCl, 0.1 M Na2CO3, 2 M urea; on-bead trypsin digestion, TMTpro labeling (18 samples), basic reverse-phase fractionation, Orbitrap LC-MS/MS, Spectrum Mill search. Labeling is radical-mediated (phenoxyl radical on Tyr), so proteins near the surface enzyme are tagged whether or not they are glycosylated.

thorup-nge.method: N-glycopeptide enrichment (NGE) on intact HEK293T cells (1e5 to 5e6 cells per sample; fresh and cryopreserved compared): cells oxidized with 1.6 mM sodium metaperiodate in PBS pH 6.5 for 15 min at 4 C, then surface aldehydes labeled with 500 uM alkoxyamine-PEG4-biotin + 5 mM 5-methoxyanthranilic acid catalyst in 1% FBS/PBS pH 6.5 for 30 min at 4 C. Pellets lysed in 8 M urea/2% SDS with Benzonase, TCEP/IAA, S-Trap trypsin + Lys-C digestion; biotinylated PEPTIDES captured on streptavidin magnetic beads (GenScript; 10 uL per 100 ug peptide) 3 h RT, washed (5 M NaCl, StimLys buffer, 50% ACN, Na2CO3 pH 11, ABC), formerly N-glycosylated peptides released with Rapid PNGase F (NEB) overnight; SDB-RPS desalting; Orbitrap Exploris 480 DIA, Spectronaut 19. Controls: labeling without NaIO4. The table used is the SURFY-filtered CSP list (Table S1B).
thorup-nge.method_source: Mol Cell Proteomics 2025, PMC12702325, Experimental Procedures 'N-glycoprotein Labeling' and 'Lysis, Digestion, and Enrichment'

thorup-wgahrp.method: WGA-HRP proximity biotinylation on intact HEK293T cells (same input series and fresh/cryopreserved design as the NGE arm): cells washed in PBS pH 6.5, incubated with 0.5 uM WGA-HRP (Vector Laboratories) + 1 mM CaCl2 for 5 min on ice, then 0.5 mM biotinyl tyramide (Sigma-Aldrich) and 0.003% H2O2 for 2 min at 37 C; quenched with sodium pyruvate / sodium ascorbate / Trolox. gasf-wang-2024.method: Global Analysis of Surface Functionality (GASF): living HeLa cells labeled with 100 uM OPA-S-S-alkyne (ortho-phthalaldehyde lysine-reactive warhead, disulfide linker, terminal alkyne) in PBS for minutes at room temperature (1 to 10 min titrated; viability checked by WST-1); the disulfide is cleaved in the reducing cytosol so any probe that enters cells is not captured. Cells lysed, lysates clicked (CuAAC with BTTP ligand) to azide-PEG4-biotin (Click Chemistry Tools), labeled proteins enriched on NeutrAvidin beads (Thermo Fisher), on-bead trypsin digestion and reductive release of probe-modified peptides; LC-MS/MS with isotopic ratio (R value) quantification of lysine reactivity, 2,639 surface lysines quantified. HEK293T profiled qualitatively only.
gasf-wang-2024.method_source: Nat Commun 2024, PMC11001985, Methods 'Materials', labeling and click sections
gasf-wang-2024.beads: NeutrAvidin agarose beads (Thermo Fisher Scientific; catalog number not stated); azide-PEG4-biotin (Click Chemistry Tools)
gasf-wang-2024.rationale: Earlier-stage iProX export: used unique K(*) peptides, peptide quality >=20, exact peptide/accession match to at least one non-transferred feature with probe-adduct mass within 15 ppm. No GO filter. SILAC dose/label-swap union; not a no-probe contrast. Site localization and extracellular orientation are not revalidated; author search FDR inherited.

vaish-hek293tshaving-2024.rationale: Protease shaving of intact cells would carry surface-accessibility evidence (as lazar-skbr3shaving-2022), and the untreated control replicates give a per-replicate baseline, but the shaved fraction is dominated by intracellular proteins: only 53 of 1,326 accessions (4.0%) fall in the canonical+likely surfaceome, far below other intact-cell inputs, which points to release from damaged or lysed cells. Hold until those are confirmed.

hypoxic-gbm-2024.method: Tumor surfaceome mapping (TS-MAP): subconfluent primary GBM cultures (U3034, U3017, U3047, AB1) and U87MG, 24 h normoxia or 1% O2 hypoxia, chilled on ice to block internalization, washed in Mg/Ca-PBS pH 8 and labeled with 1 mg/mL membrane-impermeable EZ-Link Sulfo-NHS-SS-biotin (Thermo Scientific 21331) for 30 min on ice, quenched with 0.1 M glycine. (Endocytome arm: biotinylated cells returned to 37 C for 2 h, residual surface biotin stripped with 200 mM MesNa, free biotin blocked with streptavidin.) RIPA lysis, lysate diluted and filtered, biotinylated proteins bound to a 1 mL HiTrap Streptavidin HP column (GE Healthcare 17-5112-01) on a peristaltic pump, washed on an HPLC system with Triton/RIPA/1 M NaCl buffers and eluted with 150 mM MesNa; LC-MS/MS (Proteome Discoverer export). The inventory uses the normoxic surfaceome arm.
hypoxic-gbm-2024.method_source: Acta Neuropathol Commun 2024, PMC10898066, Methods 'Biotinylation of surface and endocytosed proteins (TS-MAP)' and 'High-affinity chromatography enrichment'
hypoxic-gbm-2024.beads: HiTrap Streptavidin HP 1 mL column (GE Healthcare / Cytiva 17-5112-01); EZ-Link Sulfo-NHS-SS-biotin (Thermo 21331)

AB1's precise identity (a fourth patient-derived line vs. the established line U87MG mentioned elsewhere in the paper's abstract/validation work) could not be confirmed from the retrieved PRIDE project metadata or the Search-export filenames -- flagged for the user rather than guessed.

lasa-2024.method: Cell Surface Biotinylation (CSB; adapted from published methods) on intact primary human AML cells: 100 Leucegene specimens selected for >=60 million available cells and high blast proportion; cells chilled on ice, rinsed in PBS pH 7.4 with 1 mM CaCl2 / 0.5 mM MgCl2, incubated with 1 mg/mL Sulfo-NHS-LC-biotin (membrane-impermeant, NON-cleavable) for 1 h at 4 C, quenched with 100 mM glycine 10 min at 4 C; lysed 30 min in Surfaceome Lysis Buffer (1% Triton X-100, 150 mM NaCl, 10 mM Tris pH 7.6, 5 mM iodoacetamide, cOmplete inhibitors, Na3VO4, PMSF), debris and nuclei removed at 2,800 g and 16,000 g; biotinylated proteins captured on high-capacity streptavidin agarose resin (Thermo Fisher Scientific) 2 h at 4 C, washed with SLB, PBS/0.5% SDS, PBS/0.5% SDS/100 mM DTT, 6 M urea/Tris with 50 mM iodoacetamide, urea, PBS and water; on-bead trypsin digestion (Sigma proteomics grade, 4 ug overnight + 4 ug 4 h, 37 C); biotinylation efficiency checked by streptavidin-HRP blot. Easy-nLC 1200 + Q Exactive HF DDA (56 min gradient); MaxQuant 1.6.2.10 against UniProt human (March 2022); proteins with <2 unique peptides and CRAPome contaminants (>=5% of control runs) removed; DEP with vsn normalization and knn imputation (imputed values are not counted as detections in our table). reeves-2024.method: Cell-surface engineering / APEX2 proximity labeling on live BeWo cells (cytotrophoblast state, and forskolin-induced syncytiotrophoblast state): GGGYC-tagged cholesterol inserted into the plasma membrane, then APEX2-LPETG conjugated to it by engineered sortase A (eSrtA); cells incubated with biotin phenol (5 min, optimized to favor membrane over soluble proteins) and H2O2 to generate biotin-phenoxyl radicals that tag proximal surface proteins (labeling radius ~20 nm, so some inner-leaflet proteins are also tagged). Negative control: identical treatment without APEX2-LPETG. Lysis, streptavidin-bead enrichment, on-bead trypsin digestion, TMT multiplexing, LC-MS/MS; three experimental replicates; proteins called at >10-fold enrichment over the no-APEX2 control, then filtered by UniProt GO/subcellular-location plasma-membrane terms. Reagent-level details (bead product, cell numbers, H2O2 time) are in the Supplemental Information (Document S1), not the main text.

cellsurfer-2023.method: Microscale Cell Surface Capture (uCSC, CellSurfer 'Prepare' module) on intact primary adult human cardiac cells (cardiomyocytes, cardiac fibroblasts, microvascular endothelial and coronary artery smooth-muscle cells isolated from donor hearts; 250,000 to 10 million cells): all steps on ice; cells oxidized with 1 mM sodium metaperiodate in PBS/0.1% FBS pH 6.0 for 15 min, quenched with 2 mM sodium sulfite, labeled with 10 mM biocytin hydrazide + 50 mM 2-(aminomethyl)imidazole catalyst for 60 min at 4 C. Total lysis by VialTweeter sonication in ammonium bicarbonate/Invitrosol/ACN, TCEP/IAA, trypsin digestion; 135 to 1,289 ug peptide boiled in SDS/Tween binding buffer and captured 1 h on 100 uL Streptavidin MagBeads (GenScript L00424) on an automated liquid handler; washes with 2% SDS, high-salt Tween, Na2CO3 and ABC; formerly N-glycosylated peptides released with PNGase F overnight; SP2 cleanup; LC-MS/MS with Veneer tiering by deamidated-sequon evidence. Bead binding capacity checked by the AVIDITY assay.

cyssurf-yan.method: Cys-Surf two-stage enrichment on live Jurkat cells (plus primary CD4+/CD8+ T cells and HEK293T for other experiments): cysteines first capped in situ with iodoacetamide-alkyne, then glycan-directed cell surface capture (CSC) on intact cells (sodium periodate oxidation, 1 mM aminooxy-biotin saturating label), lysis, SP3 protein cleanup (Sera-Mag beads, EtOH washes, 0.2% SDS elution), capture of biotinylated glycoproteins on 50 uL Pierce streptavidin agarose 2 h RT, washes, on-bead reduction/alkylation and trypsin digestion; released peptides clicked (CuAAC) to biotin-azide and the IAA-labeled cysteine peptides enriched a second time on NeutrAvidin resin; LC-MS/MS with isotopic (light/heavy) ratios for oxidation state and ligandability. PNGase F check: ~53% of CSC peptides carried deamidated sequons, ~93% of those on annotated surface proteins. The inventory uses the baseline Jurkat identification list.

rms-2023.method: NOT a cell-surface labeling method. Membrane/surface proteins were enriched by differential (ultra)centrifugation: 1e7 cells scraped, hypotonic buffer (50 mM mannitol / 5 mM HEPES), 1 min sonication, 600 g clearing, then 15,000 g, CaCl2 wash, 3,000 g, 48,000 g pelleting with high-pH / high-salt washes to strip peripheral proteins; the membrane pellet was digested and analysed by LC-MS/MS (MaxQuant). The authors compared this with Sulfo-NHS-SS-biotin surface biotinylation (Thermo kit A44390, NeutrAvidin agarose, DTT elution) only in a pilot on Rh4 cells, found ~49% intracellular proteins with biotinylation vs ~35% with centrifugation, and used centrifugation for all 11 RMS lines, 3 PDXs, MRC-5 and myoblast controls. No surface-labeling evidence exists for the inventory table; surface membership is annotation-based (Bausch-Fluck list).

sbiosite-2023.method: surface Biotinylation Site Identification Technology (sBioSITe): live PC-3 cells (~80% confluent, four 15 cm dishes per replicate, 3 replicates) washed and incubated with 0.4 mM membrane-impermeant NON-cleavable sulfo-NHS-LC-biotin (APExBIO) in ice-cold PBS for 30 min at 4 C, quenched twice with 50 mM glycine, scraped and pelleted. byrnes-2022.method: Glycan-directed cell surface capture on intact primary human T cells (CD8+ effector and CD4+CD25- / regulatory populations; SILAC heavy/light cells mixed 1:1 in forward and reverse mode after activation, hypoxia or coculture): cells washed in PBS pH 6.5, oxidized with 1.6 mM NaIO4 for 20 min at 4 C, biotinylated with 1 mM biocytin hydrazide (Biotium) + 10 mM aniline for 90 min at 4 C, flash frozen. RIPA lysis with probe sonication; biotinylated glycoproteins captured on NeutrAvidin agarose (Thermo) 1 h at 4 C in Poly-Prep columns, washed with RIPA, 2 M NaCl PBS and 2 M urea; on-bead TCEP/IAA and trypsin digestion; LC-MS/MS with SILAC ratios (Wells lab).

soday-2021.method: Plasma membrane profiling on intact primary CD14+ monocytes and CD4+ T cells (five donors each, with and without overnight IFN-alpha2a): cells washed in ice-cold PBS with Mg/Ca and treated with a one-pot oxidation/biotinylation mix of 1 mM sodium metaperiodate (Thermo), 100 mM aminooxy-biotin (Biotium) and 10 mM aniline (Acros) in PBS pH 6.7 for 30 min at 4 C in the dark, quenched with 1 mM glycerol; lysed in 1% Triton X-100 with iodoacetamide, nuclei removed; biotinylated glycoproteins enriched on high-affinity streptavidin agarose beads (Thermo), washed with lysis buffer, 0.5% SDS and urea on Poly-Prep columns, on-bead DTT/IAA and trypsin digestion (3 h); TMT 10-plex, MS3 quantification. wojdyla-2020.method: Plasma membrane profiling (PMP; Weekes et al. 2012 protocol, performed with the Lehner/Williamson lab) on intact primed and naive H9 human pluripotent stem cells grown feeder-free (primed in TeSR-E8 on vitronectin; naive in t2iLGo on Matrigel; two culture replicates across two media for the primed arm used here): cell-surface sialoglycans periodate-oxidized and aminooxy-biotinylated on live cells, lysis, biotinylated glycoproteins captured on streptavidin beads, on-bead trypsin digestion, TMT labeling, offline fractionation and LC-MS/MS (MS3); >1,700 plasma-membrane proteins identified. Reagent concentrations and bead product are in the Supplemental Experimental Procedures, not the PMC main text.

leung-2020.method: Wells-lab glycan-directed cell surface capture (CSC) with SILAC quantification on intact MCF10A cells: each oncogene-transformed line (KRAS G12V, HER2, EGFR L858R, BRAF V600E, phosphomimetic MEK, myristoylated AKT) compared to the empty-vector control; live cells periodate-oxidized and labeled with biocytin hydrazide, lysed, glycoproteins captured on NeutrAvidin beads, on-bead trypsin digestion and PNGase F release of N-glycopeptides; LC-MS/MS; 654 surface proteins quantified across six lines. The main text gives only this summary; reagent concentrations and bead product are in the SI Appendix Materials and Methods. The inventory table pools conditions, hence the hold.

matta-2019.method: Aminooxy-biotin plasma-membrane profiling (Weekes protocol) on intact cells: ~90% confluent osteoarthritic-cartilage chondroprogenitor cells and hTERT-immortalized bone-marrow MSCs (175 cm2 flasks, serum-starved 1 h) washed in ice-cold PBS and incubated 1 h at 4 C in the dark with 1 mM sodium metaperiodate, 100 mM aminooxy-biotin (Biotium) and 10 mM aniline in PBS pH 6.7; quenched with 1 mM glycerol; scraped, lysed in 1% Triton X-100 with 5 mM iodoacetamide; nuclei/debris removed; biotinylated glycoproteins bound 2 h at 4 C to 250 uL Pierce NeutrAvidin agarose in Snap Cap spin columns, washed 20x each with lysis buffer, PBS/0.5% SDS (+100 mM DTT step), 6 M urea and further buffers, on-bead trypsin digestion; nanoLC-MS/MS on a Bruker Impact II, PEAKS Studio 8.5 LFQ (1 peptide minimum at 1% protein FDR); three biological replicates per cell type.
matta-2019.method_source: Sci Rep 2019, PMC6588563, Methods 'Sample preparation and enrichment of cell surface glycoproteins using aminooxy-biotin labeling'

autocsc-2019.method: autoCSC (automated, miniaturised Cell Surface Capture) on live cells: surface glycans gently oxidized with 2 mM NaIO4 (20 min, 4 C, PBS pH 6.5), then 5 mM biocytin hydrazide (Pitsch Nucleic Acids) + 5 mM 5-methoxyanthranilic acid catalyst for 1 h at 4 C; lysis in Tris/1% sodium deoxycholate/TCEP/chloroacetamide by VialTweeter sonication and 95 C; trypsin (or LysC + trypsin) digestion; ~1 mg peptide per sample (11 human cancer cell lines) processed on a liquid-handling robot by repeated aspiration through filter tips packed with streptavidin resin, extensive washing, and PNGase F release in a heated 96-well plate; manual comparison used 80 uL Streptavidin Plus UltraLink Resin (Pierce). Identification requires deamidated Asn in an N-X-S/T sequon; DIA-MS quantification. Mouse B-cell populations in the same paper are excluded here.
autocsc-2019.method_source: Nat Commun 2019, PMC6915781, Methods 'Cell surface capture - labeling and digestion' and automated enrichment

kalxdorf-2017.method: Alkoxyamine-PEG4-biotin cell-surface glycan labeling on intact cells (suspension cells or a 15 cm dish of adherent cells at 70 to 80% confluency): carbohydrates oxidized with 1 mM sodium metaperiodate in PBS pH 6.5 for 10 min at 4 C in the dark, then 1 mM alkoxyamine-PEG4-biotin + 10 mM aniline for 10 min at 4 C; pellets frozen. Lysis by boiling in 4% SDS / 50 mM DTT, sonication, 1:10 dilution; biotinylated PROTEINS captured on 15 uL high-capacity streptavidin agarose resin per sample in deep 96-well filter plates (60 min, 25 C), washed 3x 0.4% SDS/400 mM NaCl, 8x 400 mM NaCl, 8x 2 M urea/TEAB; on-resin DTT/IAA and overnight trypsin digestion (all tryptic peptides analysed; PNGase F elution tested and dropped). Orbitrap Q Exactive, label-free (Top3) quantification; monocyte-to-macrophage differentiation and kinase-inhibitor comparisons, 11 cell lines/primary cells; bead background annotated from CRAPome streptavidin-agarose entries. The inventory table is the Veneer 2024 re-report (Table S9) of these proteins.

wang-aml-surface-2015.rationale: Intact-cell sulfo-NHS-SS-biotin capture on untreated primary AML cells, full quantified list before any annotation. The authors state that proteins not enriched over the total cell extract are contaminants from lysed cells and circulating proteins, and that TCE table is not public, so the list is the raw capture (5,340 forms) with known lysis carry-over (6.9% canonical+likely). Held: the authors' own surface membership needs the surface-vs-TCE enrichment comparison, which cannot be made from the public file; an author request for the TCE sheet would resolve it.

cspa-2015.method: Wollscheid Cell Surface Capture across the Cell Surface Protein Atlas cohort (47 human cell types/samples; 1e8 suspension cells, five 15 cm dishes of adherent cells, or 200 mg to 1 g tissue per experiment): live cells treated with 2 mM sodium metaperiodate (Pierce) in PBS pH 6.5 for 15 min at 4 C in the dark, then 6.5 mM biocytin hydrazide (Biotium) for 60 min; Dounce homogenization in hypotonic buffer with iodoacetamide, nuclei removed, membranes pelleted at ~150,000 g; membrane proteins reduced/alkylated and trypsin-digested, biotinylated glycopeptides bound to Streptavidin Plus UltraLink Resin (Pierce), extensively washed, N-glycopeptides released with PNGase F (NEB); LTQ-FT-ICR / LTQ Orbitrap XL, 385 LC-MS/MS runs; only the N-glycopeptide fraction (deamidated sequon) enters the atlas. Some lymphoma lines used a variant with a reductive pre-elution before PNGase F. Table B lists all 1,492 human proteins including category 3 (lower-confidence) entries.
